items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 05 October 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil


##Synopsis##

Deepening low to the southeast of Iceland, moving to the Norwegian Sea. A ridge of high pressure over the English Channel.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 later today, then veering northerly tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, outbreaks of rain developing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly north 2 to 4, backing northwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the rain.
